turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Orders placed by 12:00 PM EST ship out the same day (Monday through Friday). Orders placed after 12:00 PM EST, on weekends, or on holidays are processed and shipped the following business day.
Once your order ships, tracking information is automatically generated and emailed to you. On rare occasions, items that are on backorder or out of stock can take up to 7 business days to ship.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once it ships, how long is delivery?
menu
Delivery times vary depending on the shipping method selected at checkout and the destination. Standard domestic orders in the U.S. ship via UPS or USPS.
For faster transit times within the U.S., expedited options such as 2nd Day Air or Next Day Air are available at checkout. International orders and shipments to military addresses (APO/FPO) may take longer due to customs processing and carrier handling.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
